items.title: Labé : l’IRE prépare la rentrée scolaire et alerte sur le déficit d’enseignants
items.description: À quelques semaines de la rentrée scolaire 2026-2027, prévue le lundi 5 octobre prochain, les services éducatifs de la région de Labé sont engagés dans les préparatifs. La prérentrée a débuté ce lundi 21 septembre dans les établissements scolaires et les différents services déconcentrés de l’éducation. Selon Elhadj Mamadou Garanké Baldé, chef de la section pédagogique de l’Inspection régionale de l’éducation (IRE) de Labé, plusieurs activités sont prévues durant cette période. Les préparatifs de la rentrée La prérentrée concerne l’Inspection régionale de l’éducation, les DPE, les DSEE ainsi que les établissements scolaires. Sur le terrain, les équipes procèdent notamment à l’assainissement des concessions scolaires et de leurs alentours, au nettoyage des salles de classe et à la réfection du mobilier scolaire. À cela s’ajoutent l’ouverture des documents pédagogiques et administratifs, ainsi que l’élaboration des emplois du temps dans les établissements. « La prérentrée a débuté ce lundi 21 septembre 2026 et nous avons beaucoup d’activités à mener au niveau de l’Inspection régionale, au niveau des DPE, des DSEE et des écoles », explique Elhadj Mamadou Garanké Baldé. Le déficit d’enseignants persiste Alors que les établissements se préparent à accueillir les élèves, le déficit d’enseignants demeure une préoccupation majeure pour les services éducatifs de la région. « Chaque année, il y a un déficit d’enseignants. C’est pour cela que le ministère de la Fonction publique prévoit de recruter de nouveaux enseignants pour combler ce déficit », indique le responsable. Dans certaines écoles, le manque de personnel est particulièrement important. Selon lui, des établissements disposant de six classes peuvent parfois ne compter que trois enseignants. Cette situation oblige l’administration à prendre des mesures pour assurer la continuité des cours. Au niveau des collèges également, certaines disciplines souffrent d’un manque de professeurs. « Il y a des collèges qui n’ont pas de professeurs pour certaines matières (…) par faute d’enseignants. Donc le problème existe et ça nous préoccupe tous », souligne-t-il. Des solutions provisoires mises en place En attendant le recrutement de nouveaux enseignants, plusieurs solutions sont mises en œuvre pour limiter les conséquences du déficit. Dans certaines localités, les communautés prennent en charge des enseignants communautaires afin de permettre aux écoles de fonctionner normalement. L’administration utilise également le système des enseignants « à cheval ». Lorsqu’un enseignant du secondaire n’atteint pas les 18 heures de service dans son établissement, il peut être envoyé dans un autre établissement pour compléter son volume horaire. « Quand vous n’avez pas les dix-huit heures dans le même établissement au secondaire, on peut vous envoyer dans un autre établissement pour combler le reste. Et l’Inspection régionale de l’éducation coordonne cela », précise Elhadj Mamadou Garanké Baldé. Dans certaines écoles, le recours aux classes multigrades permet également de faire face au manque d’enseignants et d’éviter que des élèves restent sans cours. Un appel aux enseignants et aux parents À l’approche de la rentrée, le chef de la section pédagogique de l’IRE de Labé invite les enseignants à s’impliquer pleinement dans les activités de prérentrée et à travailler en collaboration avec les directions des établissements. « À l’endroit des enseignants, ils doivent affûter leurs armes, accepter d’accompagner les directions pour ce qui est de la prérentrée, de ne pas accepter d’être surpris par la supervision, l’encadrement ou l’inspection », lance-t-il. Il adresse également un appel aux parents d’élèves et aux communautés afin qu’ils accompagnent les efforts de l’État, notamment dans la prise en charge des enseignants communautaires. À l’IRE de Labé et dans ses services déconcentrés, les préparatifs se poursuivent donc avec plusieurs défis à relever avant le 5 octobre, notamment celui du déficit d’enseignants, afin d’assurer une rentrée scolaire dans de bonnes conditions. Alpha Moussa Dieng, correspondant régional à Labé L’article Labé : l’IRE prépare la rentrée scolaire et alerte sur le déficit d’enseignants est apparu en premier sur Mediaguinee.com .

items.title: Infantino proposes consulting federations to reform FIFA
items.description: FIFA president Gianni Infantino on Monday suggested a “consultation” with the member federations to reform the world football governing body’s decision-making processes, in a letter addressed to the 211 member associations, and seen by AFP. “I will propose that the Council establish a direct, structured and time-limited consultation with confederations, Member Associations and relevant stakeholders on how FIFA’s decision-making can be further strengthened,” Infantino wrote. The 56-year-old Swiss has come under fire since his now-abandoned plan to bring private investment into the men’s and women’s World Cups. “The consultation would invite specific proposals on earlier institutional involvement, the respective roles of the President, the Bureau, the Council and the Congress, and practical ways to strengthen transparency, participation and accountability in major strategic initiatives,” the letter continued. Infantino asked for the initial proposals to be considered at the council meeting scheduled for October 15. Infantino replaced Sepp Blatter as president of FIFA in 2016. He has come under severe pressure since the announcement in late July of proposals to create a commercial subsidiary to run its biggest events, such as the World Cup and Club World Cup. The plan would have allowed private investors to acquire stakes in a company created under the FIFA Forward Enterprise (FFE) initiative. The backlash that followed led to the proposals being quickly shelved. European football’s governing body UEFA threatened to boycott FIFA competitions. It later suspended that threat, but has urged Infantino to resign and has been preparing possible legal action against him for alleged “criminal mismanagement”. FIFA confirmed earlier in September that Infantino will stand for re-election as president next March. At this stage, he is the only candidate. However, CONCACAF president Victor Montagliani is widely seen as a likely challenger. AFP The post Infantino proposes consulting federations to reform FIFA appeared first on Vanguard News .

items.title: Global Game Scouting Tournament set for September 25 kick-off in Accra
items.description: The Global Game Scouting Tournament is entering its final days of preparations ahead of its September 25-26 staging at the McDan Sports Complex in Labadi. is entering its final days of preparations ahead of its September 25-26 staging at the McDan Sports Complex in Labadi. Organised in partnership with ExcelsiorPro, the tournament is expected to attract scouts, professional clubs, academies and football agencies looking to identify emerging talent. With the event now just days away, participating players are preparing for an opportunity to showcase their abilities in front of talent evaluators with links to professional football. Organisers say players will be assessed not only on their technical qualities but also their tactical understanding, physical attributes, attitude and overall potential. Standout performers could earn recommendations for trials and other opportunities with professional clubs. The tournament will also provide additional exposure through match-day video coverage, social media updates, digital platforms, sports blogs and radio. Beyond the competition itself, organisers hope the event will help create a stronger pathway between young African footballers and professional opportunities in Europe and other parts of the world. The final preparations are now underway, with attention turning to the players who will have the chance to make their mark when the tournament gets underway on September 25. The organisers are also welcoming partnerships from clubs, academies, football agencies, scouting organisations, sponsors and other stakeholders interested in supporting football development.

items.title: Guinée : risque extrême d’inondation et fortes averses pluvio-orageuses les 22 et 23 septembre (alerte météo)
items.description: L’Agence nationale de la météorologie (ANM) a émis, ce lundi 21 septembre 2026, un bulletin d’alerte faisant état d’un risque extrême lié à de fortes précipitations et à des phénomènes pluvio-orageux au cours des prochaines 48 heures en Guinée. Selon l’ANM, de fortes averses accompagnées d’orages sont attendues du mardi 22 au mercredi 23 septembre 2026, avec une situation particulièrement préoccupante dans les zones littorales. D’après les prévisions météorologiques, la dégradation des conditions atmosphériques débutera mardi 22 septembre en Haute-Guinée, avant de progresser vers les autres régions du pays et d’atteindre la façade littorale dans la soirée. L’activité pluvio-orageuse devrait rester soutenue durant la journée et la nuit du mercredi 23 septembre. L’alerte demeure en vigueur jusqu’au jeudi 24 septembre à 15 heures. Un risque d’inondation jugé très élevé Face à cette situation météorologique qualifiée de probable et de gravité extrême, l’ANM alerte sur le risque de dégâts matériels importants. Le risque d’inondation est jugé très élevé dans les zones concernées, avec une vigilance particulière recommandée le long de la bande côtière, où les fortes précipitations pourraient entraîner des accumulations importantes d’eau. Les consignes de sécurité de l’ANM Pour limiter les risques d’accidents et de pertes en vies humaines, l’Agence nationale de la météorologie appelle les populations à observer plusieurs mesures de précaution : Redoubler de vigilance dans les zones à risque, notamment les secteurs habituellement exposés aux inondations ; Respecter strictement les consignes des autorités pendant toute la durée des intempéries ; Limiter les déplacements, notamment à pied ou en véhicule, au moment du déclenchement des orages ; Éviter de rester à l’extérieur pendant les épisodes orageux et s’abriter dans un endroit sûr. L’ANM recommande ainsi aux populations des zones concernées de rester attentives à l’évolution de la situation météorologique et de suivre régulièrement les bulletins officiels.

items.title: Alausa urges parents to return children to 117 unity colleges
items.description: By Joseph Erunke, Abuja The Federal Ministry of Education has urged parents and guardians to ensure that their children and wards return to their respective federal unity colleges, as the 2026/2027 academic session has commenced nationwide. The call was made by the Minister of Education, Dr. Tunji Alausa, amid concerns over communications purportedly issued in the name of a body calling itself the National Parent-Teacher Association ,PTA, of the federal unity colleges. In a statement issued on Monday night,by the Director of Press and Public Relations, Folasade Boriowo, the ministry disowned the association, declaring that it neither recognises nor authorised the group to speak for the 117 Federal Unity Colleges across the country. According to the ministry, the association does not represent the individual PTAs of the colleges and has no mandate to issue directives, appeals or other communications on behalf of parents, guardians or the institutions. The ministry therefore directed parents, guardians and members of the public to disregard communications emanating from the association, stressing that such directives have no official standing. It advised parents and guardians to rely only on official communications from the Federal Ministry of Education and the management of their respective federal unity colleges on issues concerning their children, wards and school activities. The ministry said the Minister had also reaffirmed the Federal Government’s commitment to effective administration of the federal unity colleges and the provision of a conducive learning environment for students throughout the 2026/2027 academic session. Alausa, on behalf of the ministry, further assured that the government would continue to provide the necessary support for students’ academic and overall development during the new school year. items.title: Fodé Bintou Keïta, procureur sortant du TPI de Kankan, fait ses adieux : « Je pars avec fierté, gratitude et un profond respect »
items.description: Quitter Kankan, mais pas sans un dernier hommage. Après plusieurs mois à la tête du parquet du Tribunal de première instance, Fodé Bintou Keïta a prononcé un discours empreint d’émotion lors de la cérémonie de passation de service. Magistrats, collaborateurs, forces de défense et de sécurité, autorités, avocats, religieux, citoyens et partenaires de la justice : le procureur sortant a tenu à saluer ceux qui ont accompagné son passage dans la ville avant de rejoindre son nouveau poste à Guéckédou. Fodé Bintou Keïta tourne la page de Kankan. Face aux magistrats, autorités administratives et locales, forces de défense et de sécurité, avocats, agents judiciaires, religieux et représentants de la presse, il a livré un message de reconnaissance à ceux avec lesquels il a travaillé durant son passage à la tête du parquet. « Quitter une fonction n’est jamais anodin, quitter une équipe comme la nôtre est encore plus difficile, voire atroce », a-t-il déclaré, laissant transparaître son attachement à ses collaborateurs. Un hommage à toute la chaîne judiciaire Dans son intervention, le procureur sortant a salué les différents acteurs de la chaîne judiciaire. Du parquet général au siège du Tribunal de première instance, en passant par les greffiers, secrétaires, stagiaires, agents pénitentiaires, officiers de police judiciaire et autres personnels de justice, Fodé Bintou Keïta a reconnu l’engagement de chacun. Il a particulièrement insisté sur la collaboration avec le parquet général, dont il a salué l’accompagnement et les conseils durant l’exercice de ses fonctions. Les personnels souvent moins visibles dans le fonctionnement quotidien de la justice, notamment les secrétaires, les stagiaires et les techniciens de surface, ont également reçu ses remerciements. Police, gendarmerie et douanes également saluées Le procureur sortant a aussi adressé ses remerciements aux forces de défense et de sécurité. Police, gendarmerie, unités d’intervention et services des douanes ont été salués pour leur contribution à la lutte contre la criminalité et au maintien de la sécurité dans la région. Pour Fodé Bintou Keïta, le fonctionnement de la justice repose également sur la collaboration entre les différents services, chacun dans le respect de ses prérogatives. Les autorités administratives locales ont également été citées, notamment le préfet de Kankan, avec lequel il a travaillé au sein de la commission de défense et de sécurité. Un message au nouveau procureur La cérémonie a également marqué l’arrivée du successeur de Fodé Bintou Keïta à la tête du parquet de Kankan, Ibrahima Nkamara. Le procureur sortant a invité ses anciens collaborateurs à lui apporter leur soutien et à poursuivre leur travail dans un esprit de loyauté et de professionnalisme. « Kankan est bien servi grâce à son arrivée », a-t-il déclaré à propos de son successeur. Il a également appelé les membres du parquet à constituer autour de lui un « mur de soutien intellectuel et moral ». « Une partie de moi restera ici » Le moment le plus personnel de son intervention est venu lorsqu’il s’est adressé aux populations de Kankan. Fodé Bintou Keïta a salué l’accueil qui lui a été réservé depuis sa prise de fonction et exprimé sa gratitude envers les habitants de la ville. « Je pars avec fierté, avec gratitude et avec un profond respect pour chacun d’entre vous », a-t-il déclaré. Avant de tourner définitivement la page, le magistrat a livré une dernière phrase chargée de symbolique : « Même si je m’éloigne de Kankan, une partie de moi restera ici. » Désormais appelé à servir à Guéckédou, Fodé Bintou Keïta quitte Kankan après avoir adressé ses remerciements à ses collaborateurs et aux différents partenaires de la justice. Une nouvelle étape professionnelle s’ouvre pour lui, tandis qu’il dit vouloir conserver les liens tissés durant son passage dans la ville. Karifa Kansan Doumbouya, correspondant à Kankan L’article Fodé Bintou Keïta, procureur sortant du TPI de Kankan, fait ses adieux : « Je pars avec fierté, gratitude et un profond respect » est apparu en premier sur Mediaguinee.com .

items.title: Le passeport guinéen de Cellou Dalein Diallo « révoqué » !
items.description: L’Union des Forces Démocratiques de Guinée (UFDG), parti dissous, affirme que le passeport ordinaire de son président, Cellou Dalein Diallo, a été révoqué, l’empêchant ainsi de se rendre à New York pour participer à des rencontres organisées en marge de la 81e session de l’Assemblée générale des Nations Unies. Dans un communiqué publié ce lundi 21 septembre 2026, la formation politique dissoute affirme que son président devait se rendre à New York « pour participer, comme il le fait depuis plusieurs années, à des réunions de haut niveau organisées en marge de l’Assemblée générale des Nations Unies et auxquelles il est invité ». Selon l’UFDG, Cellou Dalein Diallo avait déjà accompli les formalités nécessaires et reçu sa carte d’embarquement pour le vol d’Ethiopian Airlines. Mais, à la dernière minute, la compagnie lui aurait indiqué que les autorités américaines, après réception d’une copie de son passeport et de son visa, l’avaient informée que « le passeport avait été révoqué par les autorités émettrices ». « En conséquence, la compagnie n’était pas autorisée à l’embarquer », rapporte l’UFDG dans son communiqué. La formation politique dissoute affirme que le passeport concerné comportait « les visas de plusieurs pays européens et nord-américains, dont les États-Unis ». Face à cette situation, l’UFDG dit exprimer « sa vive indignation » et « condamne avec la dernière énergie cette violation des droits élémentaires de son Président ». Le parti affirme que cette décision s’inscrit dans une série d’actions visant son président. Il évoque notamment « les spoliations et les diffamations » dont Cellou Dalein Diallo aurait été victime, ainsi que « les manœuvres utilisées par la junte pour l’empêcher de se faire enrôler sur le fichier électoral guinéen ». L’UFDG revient également sur sa propre situation, rappelant que « la longue suspension et, finalement, la dissolution de l’UFDG s’inscrivent dans la même dynamique d’exclusion du Parti et de son Président ». Dans son communiqué, le parti dissous accuse le président Mamadi Doumbouya de vouloir « priver ses adversaires politiques de l’exercice de leurs droits et libertés ». L’UFDG va plus loin en évoquant d’éventuelles mesures futures contre son président. « Nul ne serait surpris si, demain, il prenait un acte pour déchoir Cellou Dalein Diallo de sa nationalité guinéenne ou faisait lancer un mandat d’arrêt international contre lui », affirme le communiqué. Pour le moment, aucune réaction des autorités guinéennes ou américaines n’a été rapportée concernant ces accusations ni les circonstances du refus d’embarquement de Cellou Dalein Diallo. items.description: À la clôture, ce lundi 21 septembre 2026, du guichet de dépôt des candidatures pour l’élection du Comité exécutif de la Fédération guinéenne de football (FGF), trois listes ont été officiellement enregistrées, selon des sources concordantes. Après plusieurs désistements enregistrés ces dernières heures, la course à la présidence de l’instance dirigeante du football guinéen se resserre autour de trois candidats : deux figures bien connues du paysage sportif national et un prétendant moins attendu. Les trois candidats en lice Les trois listes déposées sont conduites par : Dr Ibrahima Kalil Kaba « Lilou », président du Karfamoriah FC ; Mamadou Antonio Souaré, président du Conseil d’administration du Horoya AC ; Mamadi Doumbouya, président de l’Union FC, évoluant en Ligue 2. Les premières confirmations Joint par Guinéenews, Dr Ibrahima Kalil Kaba « Lilou » a confirmé le dépôt officiel de sa liste auprès des instances compétentes. Le camp de Mamadou Antonio Souaré a également confirmé le dépôt de son dossier dans les délais impartis. De son côté, Mamadi Doumbouya n’a pas pu être joint pour le moment. Toutefois, une source proche du dossier a confirmé de manière catégorique le dépôt de sa candidature. Cap sur le scrutin du 27 octobre La course à la présidence de la FGF entre désormais dans une nouvelle phase. Après le dépôt des dossiers, l’attention se porte sur leur examen et leur validation par la commission électorale. Une fois les candidatures définitivement validées, les différents candidats disposeront de quelques semaines pour mener leur campagne et tenter de convaincre les délégués appelés à prendre part au scrutin. L’élection du nouveau Comité exécutif de la Fédération guinéenne de football est prévue le 27 octobre 2026.

items.title: Police arrest notorious kidnap suspect, recover drone in Kano
items.description: By Hadiza Yusuf Kano State Police Command has arrested a suspected kidnapper and recovered a drone during separate clearance operations across the state. The command said the suspect, identified as 35-year-old Habibu Bello of Kunkumi Town, Makarfi Local Government Area of Kaduna State, was arrested on September 14, 2026. In a statement issued on Monday, the Police Public Relations Officer, CSP Abdullahi Haruna Kiyawa, said Bello was arrested by operatives of the Anti-Kidnapping Squad following credible intelligence. The police alleged that the suspect was a member of a syndicate involved in kidnapping, armed robbery and cattle rustling across Kano, Katsina and Kaduna states. According to the command, the investigation following his arrest also led to the arrest of another suspected member of the group, identified as Mudam from Kwanar Dangora. Police said Bello confessed to involvement in several kidnapping and cattle-rustling incidents. The command alleged that he was involved in the abduction of Hajiya Binta of Kwanar Dangora, for which a ransom of ₦20 million was reportedly paid. “The suspect was also linked to the alleged kidnapping of a household in Gwarzo Local Government Area, Kano State, as well as cattle-rustling activities across the three states,” he said. The police said the investigation was ongoing, while efforts were being made to arrest other members of the alleged syndicate and recover their weapons. In a separate operation, police operatives recovered a cine-camera drone at Hawan Tarau Village in Bebeji Local Government Area of Kano State. The command said the drone, marked GT 50, was found lying on the ground during a clearance operation on September 17 at about 2pm. “Efforts were ongoing to establish the source and owner of the drone,” he added. The Commissioner of Police, Ibrahim Adamu Bakori, commended the officers involved in the operations and said the command would continue working with neighbouring police commands to prevent criminals from using the borders as safe havens. He also urged residents to report suspicious movements to the nearest police station or through the command’s emergency lines. The post Police arrest notorious kidnap suspect, recover drone in Kano appeared first on Vanguard News .

items.title: Obi, Atiku’s 2023 Rivers ‘victory’ exists only on social media — Wike
items.description: By Omeiza Ajayi Minister of the Federal Capital Territory FCT, Nyesom Wike, has dismissed claims by the 2023 presidential candidate of the Labour Party, Peter Obi, and the “Obidient” movement that they won the 2023 presidential election in Rivers State, declaring that any such victory existed only on social media and in their imagination, and maintaining that neither Obi nor the Peoples Democratic Party’s Atiku Abubakar could defeat him in the state. Speaking on TVC’s Journalists Hangout programme, monitored in Abuja on Monday evening, Wike insisted that political victories are determined at the polling units and declared by the Independent National Electoral Commission INEC, not on social media or on the strength of selective polling unit results. “They won in their imagination,” Wike said, responding to questions on whether his political support in Rivers State remains organic. “I have always told people: they won in their imagination. Nobody declared them to have won. I have been in this system; I am in this game. When Obi went to the Timber Market or somewhere in Rivers State and they were shouting ‘Obi! Obi!’, is that how you win an election?” He faulted claims of victory based on isolated polling units, noting that Rivers State has over 7,000 polling units spread across 23 local government areas. “Out of over 7,000 polling units, until all results have come in, even if 200 polling units come out and say Obi or Atiku has won, it does not convince me. They went to the tribunal, were they able to tender or prove to the court that they won the election? You can win on social media, but I am not interested in social media winning. I am interested practically in the results on the ground, who won, and who was declared,” he said. Addressing suggestions that political rivals in Rivers State were ganging up against him ahead of the 2027 general elections, the FCT minister expressed confidence in his political standing, describing the coming contest as one he expects to be his easiest yet. “I started this game in 1999 as a local government chairman. In all my elections, it has never been easy. In 2015, they said it would be difficult; I won. In 2019, the federal might and soldiers were against me, yet I won,” Wike recalled, disclosing for the first time that his late brother, Herbert Wigwe, had advised him to flee ahead of the 2019 election because of federal pressure, a suggestion he rejected before going on to win. Wike maintained that his political strength was rooted in his track record and direct connection with the people of Rivers State rather than in federal backing or political coalitions. “Anybody telling you today that people are fighting me in Rivers and that it will be difficult, brother, I have never had an election that has been easy, but this one will be the easiest election as far as I know. The factors are clear. What are you going to tell Rivers people now? What will you present to them that will make them believe that following you will be more beneficial than what they have today?” he said. The post Obi, Atiku’s 2023 Rivers ‘victory’ exists only on social media — Wike appeared first on Vanguard News .

items.title: Dar meets EU foreign policy chief, stresses importance of GSP+ for Pakistan's trade ties with the bloc
items.description: Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar stressed the significance of GSP+ for Pakistan’s trade relations with the European Union in a meeting with EU High Representative for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy Kaja Kallas on Monday, according to a statement by the Foreign Office (FO). The meeting took place on the sidelines of the 81st session of the United Nations General Assembly (UNGA) in New York, which will be held from Sep 21-25. The deputy premier highlighted “the importance Pakistan attaches to its partnership with the European Union, particularly in trade and economic cooperation”. He stressed the significance of GSP+ for Pakistan’s trade relations with the EU, the FO said. The two sides also exchanged views on regional and global developments, with DPM Dar appreciating the EU’s constructive engagement with Pakistan during recent regional developments, as well as its recognition of Pakistan’s efforts towards de-escalation and dialogue. He called for a return to “the path of dialogue and diplomacy” and full implementation “by all parties” of the Islamabad Memorandum of Understanding signed between the US and Iran earlier this year, according to the statement. “Both sides agreed to maintain close engagement on matters of mutual interest,” the FO added. The meeting took place against the backdrop of an intense engagement between Islamabad and Brussels over a trading scheme and its future. The current EU Generalised Scheme of Preferences framework is set to expire at the end of this year, and Pakistan is required to seek inclusion in the successor regime, which would carry more stringent requirements. Though the new trading framework will take effect with the turn of the year, Pakistan and other existing beneficiaries will continue to receive preferences during a two-year transition period ending on Dec 31, 2028. But the transition does not amount to an automatic continuation of the facility for the two-year period, or a roll over into the new scheme. A European Commission assessment covering the years 2023-25, released in July this year, concluded that Pakistan had faced compliance issues with its obligations, regressed in a number of areas and made limited positive change. Moreover, while acknowledging legislative and administrative measures, it noted that much of the progress had yet to translate into improvements on the ground. The report had identified significant concerns relating to enforced disappearances and extrajudicial killings, freedom of expression, journalists’ and minority rights, judicial independence, access to justice and forced labour. Diplomatic discussions between Pakistan and the EU suggest that Islamabad is aware of the gravity of the situation, though questions remain over whether it has yet moved decisively towards addressing the concerns that Brussels has repeatedly raised. Earlier this month, the European Union’s ambassador to Pakistan had cautioned that GSP+ benefits could not be taken for granted. EU imports from Pakistan reached €9.4 billion in 2022 before declining to €7.9bn in 2023 because of weaker European demand and recovering to €8.3bn in 2024. The EU has remained Pakistan’s largest export destination, accounting for 28 per cent of its total exports, while textiles and clothing constituted around 70 to 76pc of Pakistani exports to the European market. About 90pc of Pakistan’s exports to the EU remained eligible for GSP+ preferences during 2022-2024, with utilisation averaging 93pc and recovering to 95pc in 2024. According to the European Commission, Pakistan benefitted from approximately €732 million in tariff exemptions last year alone, equivalent to around 9pc of its exports to the European Union.

items.title: « La grève n’était que suspendue » : à deux semaines de la rentrée, l’Intersyndicale de l’Éducation hausse le ton
items.description: ​À quatorze jours seulement de la rentrée des classes fixée au 5 octobre prochain, le ciel s'assombrit au-dessus du système éducatif guinéen. Réunis en conférence de presse ce lundi 21 septembre 2026 au siège du SLECG, à Donka, les leaders de l'Intersyndicale de l'Éducation (SLECG, SNE et FSPE) ont dénoncé la violation du protocole d'accord du 3 janvier dernier et menacé de paralyser le secteur pré-universitaire sur l'ensemble du territoire national. ​Alors que les autorités ministérielles prônent une « rentrée apaisée », le climat social entre le gouvernement et le corps enseignant est au bord de l'explosion. En cause : le non-respect des engagements pris en début d'année, en particulier la situation critique des enseignants contractuels dits « moyenneurs » et le blocage prolongé des salaires de plusieurs agents. ​La pomme de la discorde : le recrutement direct des contractuels « moyenneurs » ​Pour les représentants syndicaux, le gouvernement est revenu de manière unilatérale sur les termes de l'accord du 3 janvier 2026. L'article 7 stipulait pourtant clairement que la priorité au prochain engagement serait accordée aux enseignants contractuels communautaires ayant obtenu la moyenne lors des évaluations pratiques, sans repasser par un nouveau concours. La ​Secrétaire générale du Syndicat Libre des Enseignants et Chercheurs de Guinée (SLECG), Kadiatou Bah n'a pas caché son amertume face à ce qu'elle qualifie de rupture de confiance : ​« Aujourd'hui est un grand jour. Ce jour marque l'expression de notre désagrément, de notre déception et de notre surprise face à nos partenaires sociaux. Ils nous ont fait croire et comprendre qu'à la rentrée, les classes reprendraient dans un climat apaisé […]. Mais hélas ! Qu'observons-nous aujourd'hui ? La violation flagrante de notre protocole d'accord signé le 3 janvier 2026 », a-t-elle déploré. ​Pointant du doigt une injustice criante dans la répartition par zones géographiques, la syndicaliste rappelle que ces enseignants ont déjà satisfait à toutes les exigences administratives et pédagogiques : ​« Quand on parle d'un « prochain engagement », il ne s'agit pas d'un nouveau concours ni de la mise en place d'une commission pour statuer sur quiconque. Ces enseignants contractuels communautaires ont déjà franchi toutes les étapes : le recensement, la biométrie et le concours en pratique de classe […]. « Engagement » est différent de « concours », n'est-ce pas ? » L'ouverture des classes menacée ​Elle avertit par ailleurs que sans correction immédiate, la rentrée ne pourra matériellement pas avoir lieu dans plusieurs localités de l'intérieur : « Comment parler d'une rentrée paisible quand nos jeunes qui sont en classe à l'intérieur du pays restent à la maison ? Les écoles seront fermées », a martelé la syndicaliste. ​Salaires bloqués et précarité : « L'enseignant guinéen est laissé pour compte » ​Outre la question du recrutement, le blocage persistant des salaires de plusieurs enseignants depuis 2024 alimente la colère des syndicats. Une situation jugée inhumaine et injustifiable par Algasimou Barry, secrétaire général de la Fédération Guinéenne des Syndicats de l'Éducation (FSPE). ​« Le salaire d'un enseignant est sacré ! On ne bloque pas un salaire pour le simple plaisir de le bloquer […]. Depuis 2024, des enseignants sont bloqués, des pères de famille. Certains ont rendu l'âme, d'autres sont malades aujourd'hui, alités. Il y a même eu des cas de divorce. Où est le social ? » alerte le syndicaliste . ​Soulignant le rôle clé de l'éducation dans le développement de la nation, le leader de la FSPE regrette le mépris affiché selon lui envers la corporation : ​ « Aujourd'hui, l'éducation guinéenne est laissée pour compte. L'enseignant guinéen est dans une situation précaire, nous n'avons aucune considération. La réalité, c'est cela ! […] Tant qu'on continuera à piétiner cette éducation, on ne parlera pas de développement. » ​Un ultimatum clair : « La grève n'était que suspendue » ​L'Intersyndicale de l'Éducation hausse le ton et prévient que la patience des enseignants a atteint ses limites. Si la grève avait été levée à la suite des négociations de décembre et janvier derniers, elle reste le principal levier d'action à la disposition des syndicats pour faire plier l'exécutif. ​Algasimou Barry s'est voulu catégorique devant les journalistes et les enseignants mobilisés à Donka : ​« Nous allons brandir l'arme fatale. Si ce gouvernement ne cherche pas à débloquer la situation qui prévaut dans l'éducation […], c'est non négociable ! Si tous ces problèmes que nous venons de dépeindre ne sont pas satisfaits, la grève n'était que suspendue. Je le répète bien : la grève n'était que suspendue ! » ​Appelant à un mot d'ordre d'inactivité plutôt qu'à des manifestations de rue, le syndicaliste conclut en lançant un appel solennel à la base : ​« Nos grèves sont civilisées. Si l'on n'est pas satisfait, personne ne descend dans la rue. On dit aux enseignants : « Restez à la maison. » […] Camarades enseignantes et enseignants de Guinée, restez mobilisés ! Ne cédez pas à l'intimidation, ne cédez pas à la peur. Restez à l'écoute de l'Intersyndicale de l'Éducation. Nous combattrons jusqu'au bout », a-t-il lancé. ​À deux semaines de l'échéance du 5 octobre, la balle est désormais dans le camp du Ministère de l'Enseignement Pré-Universitaire et de l'Alphabétisation. Sans geste concret du gouvernement dans les prochains jours, l'année scolaire 2026-2027 pourrait débuter par des salles de classe désertes sur le territoire national.

items.title: Atletico hit back at Mourinho after referee rant
items.description: By Adegboyega Adeleye Atletico Madrid have hit back at Jose Mourinho after the Real Madrid manager accused referees of making key errors during Sunday’s Madrid derby defeat. Mourinho arrived at his post-match press conference carrying printed screenshots of two incidents he believed should have resulted in Atletico players being sent off during Real Madrid’s 2-1 defeat. The Portuguese manager displayed the images to reporters and argued that Real could have faced the second half against nine Atletico players if the decisions had gone in their favour. “We can skip the press conference because the story of the match is right here,” Mourinho said while showing the printed images. “Those were two clear red cards. Given the difficulties we faced afterwards playing 11 against 10, we can only imagine what 50 minutes of 11 against nine would have been like.” Atletico responded on Monday through their official X account with a pointed message aimed at Mourinho and the wider complaints about refereeing. Their first post showed a sheet of paper emerging from a printer carrying the hashtag #StopAcosoArbitralYA, which translates as “stop referee harassment now”. The club then posted an image of Mourinho holding the screenshots at his press conference, accompanied by the same message. The response quickly attracted more than two million views on X within two hours, according to BBC Sport. Atletico have previously used their social-media channels to respond to rivals, including posts aimed at Barcelona during the Catalan club’s pursuit of Atletico forward Julian Alvarez. Mourinho’s complaints came after Real Madrid suffered their second defeat of the season, following a 1-0 loss to Real Betis earlier in September. Real Madrid’s match report also blamed the defeat on what it described as “dreadful refereeing”. Atletico coach Diego Simeone, however, urged Mourinho and other managers to remain within the bounds of respect when discussing officials and fellow coaches. “I understand that we’re in a privileged position with a lot of public scrutiny, as coaches, and whether it’s Mourinho, [Barcelona manager Hansi] Flick, [Real Betis boss Manuel] Pellegrini, me, or anyone else, we need to be careful about what we say,” Simeone said. “We have to know how to respect others, the referees, our colleagues. And when someone crosses that line of respect, it’s not right – you can’t cross that line.” Mourinho, meanwhile, praised his players for their response despite the defeat, saying they had shown “great class and character” during the first half. The exchange adds another layer to the latest Madrid derby after Atletico claimed a 2-1 victory over their city rivals. items.title: Queiroz outlines long-term plan to rebuild Black Stars for 2030 World Cup
items.description: Carlos Queiroz says Ghana must begin laying the foundations for the next generation of the Black Stars as he targets a team capable of qualifying for and competing at the 2030 FIFA World Cup. The Portuguese coach, who led Ghana at the 2026 World Cup, has returned for a second spell after his short-term contract expired following the tournament. With his future initially uncertain, Queiroz has now outlined a long-term vision for the Black Stars, insisting the rebuilding process must begin with the ongoing 2027 Africa Cup of Nations qualifying campaign. “Step by step, we have to plant the seeds of rebuilding or, in another word, build a strong team, a capable team that will be able to qualify and compete in the World Cup 2030,” Queiroz said. The 2027 AFCON qualifiers will therefore provide the starting point for another phase of rebuilding, with Queiroz looking to establish a core of players who can form the backbone of the national team in the years ahead. His plans have already been affected by injuries and withdrawals, with several key players unavailable for the opening qualifier against Côte d’Ivoire in Bouaké. Mohammed Kudus has withdrawn from the squad to continue his recovery, while Thomas Partey was not called up due to a hamstring problem. Lorient defender Nathaniel Adjei has also pulled out through injury. Despite the setbacks, Queiroz believes the Black Stars must use the current period to build a squad with the depth and quality needed to compete beyond the immediate AFCON campaign. Ghana begin their qualifying campaign against Côte d’Ivoire on Thursday before hosting The Gambia in Accra on September 29. For Queiroz, however, the bigger objective is to use the current cycle to lay the groundwork for a Black Stars team capable of qualifying for and competing at the 2030 World Cup.

Speaking on a recent episode of the KK Show, Ola said he has never slept in a house he bought with his own money because paying rent motivates him to work harder. The luxury influencer explained that the financial responsibility of paying rent keeps him focused and reminds him that he needs to continue working to meet his obligations. He said: “If I sleep in a house I bought with my own money, I’ll relax. No! Rent, pay rent make you know say you wan pay 50 million naira. “Pay, so that you go know say you have to work. If you go dey your house wey you buy. No, it’s fine to stay in your house, that’s my own opinion, don’t let that judge your life oo.” View this post on Instagram Ola, however, stressed that his approach should not be treated as a general rule, noting that people’s financial circumstances differ. “No, it depends on your reality,” he said. “Some people now, na the car wey dem go buy, go buy them houses. items.title: California declares state of emergency ahead of El Nino
items.description: California’s governor on Monday declared a state of emergency as the US west coast readies for what is expected to be a damaging El Nino. Forecasters say the coming months could bring powerful and damaging storms to the region because of this weather pattern, with the threat of higher-than-usual tides that could trigger coastal flooding. Governor Gavin Newsom said the state needed to get ahead of problems instead of waiting for them to happen. “This action is about giving communities the support they need, giving first responders the tools to do their jobs, and giving families the confidence that their state is ready,” he said. “We are preparing for this El Nino early because every Californian deserves to be safe in their home, connected to their community, and protected when severe weather comes.” Monday’s declaration is procedural and intended to make it easier for state agencies to access resources, and to pre-position flood-fighting supplies like sandbags and pumps. The proclamation also prepares the California National Guard to support flood response, search-and-rescue, engineering, and logistics missions when needed, officials said. El Nino is the warming phase of a natural cycle in the tropical Pacific, known as the El Nino-Southern Oscillation (ENSO), and comes along every two to seven years. It sets in when east-to-west trade winds ease, allowing warm water which normally collects in the western Pacific Ocean to slide back east and rise to the surface. When those warmer-than-average surface temperatures last for a few months, they cause more storms and clouds over the region, which in turn cause ripple effects through the entire global atmosphere: hotter and drier conditions in some places, cooler and wetter in others. Human-caused climate change increases El Nino’s impacts. A warmer atmosphere holds more moisture, so El Nino-linked rains can turn more extreme. It also dries out soil, deepening drought where El Nino brings it. This year’s El Nino has a 69 percent chance of becoming the strongest on record, according to the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration, and is already unleashing extreme weather across the globe even though it is not expected to peak until October-December. California’s coastline has already been battered by storms that have damaged or destroyed homes. Coastal erosion also forced the cancellation of a music festival in Santa Monica that had been set to feature The Killers, Olivia Dean and Jack White. items.title: IHRC releases names of 37 miners who died in NSCDC custody
items.description: By Omeiza Ajayi The International Human Rights Commission IHRC has released the names of suspected illegal miners who died in the custody of the Nigeria Security and Civil Defence Corps NSCDC in Niger State. The victims were among scores of suspects arrested during operations conducted on September 15 and 16 around Lt Gen Mohammed Inuwa Wushishi Estate in Minna, the Niger State capital. The state’s NSCDC Commandant at the time, Suberu Aniviye, had said in a statement that scores of the detained suspects were found dead in the early hours of Thursday following a suspected outbreak of disease. Following the development, the Federal Government suspended the Niger State NSCDC commandant and ordered a full investigation into the circumstances surrounding the deaths. According to a report by The Cable, the IHRC said it had compiled a list of the 37 deceased, disclosing that the organisation obtained the initial list from the records of the General Hospital, Minna. The International Peace Ambassador at the IHRC, Awaisu Giwa, said the names were provided by the mortuary attendant on the instruction of the hospital’s Chief Medical Director, adding that four additional names had since been added to the list after relatives of victims whose names were not initially recorded approached the commission. “We got the list from the CMD of the general hospital. It was written by the mortuary attendant for us, but we are going to the hospital tomorrow for the list to be on the official letterhead of the hospital. The CMD was the one who instructed the mortuary attendant to give us the names. Some people whose relatives were missing are beginning to report in our office”, Giwa said. Giwa said the list would also be used to facilitate compensation for families of those who died in the incident. The names of the deceased, as compiled by the IHRC and cross-checked against the General Hospital’s records, are: Ibrahim Sani, Fahad Sa’adu, Abdulsalam Ismail, Usman Aliyu, Abubakar Alhaji, Sani Nasir, Sanusi Khalid, Ahmad Aliyu, Safiyanu Abdullahi, Suleiman Dantala, Idris Haruna, Sani Yakubu, Safiyanu Abubakar, Abdullahi Abubakar, Abubakar Musa, Abdul Mudassir, Suleiman Lawal, Usman Abdullahi, Samuel Sambo, Ibrahim Musa, Yusuf Nasiru, Umar Lawal, Isyaku Amisu, Bissallah Adamu, Abdulbari Suleiman, Shafisu Lado, Usman Ahmad, Usman Ibrahim, Sani Isyaku, Musa Ibrahim, Idris Bashir, Kabiru Suleiman and Emmanuel Emeka. Four additional names, said not to have been included in the General Hospital’s list, were also provided by the IHRC: Mu’awiya AbdulKarim, Abdul Gafar Abubakar, Usman Haruna and Yaro Salihu Soba. The post IHRC releases names of 37 miners who died in NSCDC custody appeared first on Vanguard News .

items.title: Niger : Abdourahamane Oumarou prend les commandes du ministère de la Refondation et de la Promotion des Valeurs sociales…
items.description: Une cérémonie de passation de service a eu lieu au ministère de la Refondation et de la Promotion des Valeurs sociales, ce lundi matin à Niamey, marquant ainsi , l’installation effective de M. Abdourahamane Oumarou à la tête de ce département ministériel stratégique. Cette rencontre officielle a réuni le nouveau ministre, Abdourahamane Oumarou, et son prédécesseur, Cheikh Ali Ben Salah, dans un climat marqué par la continuité des actions engagées au titre du Programme de la Refondation de la République 2025–2029. Lors de cette passation, les deux responsables ont passé en revue les dossiers en cours, notamment les chantiers liés à la promotion des valeurs civiques, à la cohésion nationale et à l’ancrage des réformes issues de la Charte de la Refondation, promulguée en mars 2025. Nommé par décret présidentiel le 15 septembre 2026, Abdourahamane Oumarou, ancien député et figure du militantisme panafricaniste, succède à Cheikh Ali Ben Salah dans un portefeuille considéré comme central dans l’architecture politique de la transition. Le ministère de la Refondation et de la Promotion des Valeurs sociales est chargé de porter, au niveau du ouvernemental, la mise en œuvre des orientations politiques liées à la refondaxtion de l’État, à la moralisation de la vie publique et à la promotion d’un nouveau contrat social. Avec cette installation, le gouvernement nigérien poursuit la phase opérationnelle de son réaménagement récent, intervenu après la nomination, la semaine dernière, de quatre nouveaux ministres dans des secteurs clés (Agriculture et Élevage, Énergie, Communication et Nouvelles technologies de l’information, et Refondation). Des mesures concrètes sont attendues dans les prochaines semaines pour traduire, sur le terrain, les engagements de la Refondation en matière de gouvernance, de citoyenneté et de cohésion sociale. L'assistance a aussi imploré le Tout-Puissant de combler le Souverain en les personnes du Prince Héritier Moulay El Hassan, du Prince Moulay Rachid et de l'ensemble des membres de l'Illustre Famille Royale. items.title: Tesla déploie Grok au Maroc
items.description: L’assistant d’intelligence artificielle de Tesla doit prochainement être étendu au marché marocain. Le constructeur américain a intégré le Maroc à son périmètre régional de disponibilité de Grok, dont l’activation est liée à la version logicielle 2026.32.6 ou ultérieure. Tesla étend progressivement l’accès à Grok, son assistant d’intelligence artificielle développé avec xAI, à de nouveaux marchés. Le Maroc figure désormais dans le périmètre régional documenté par le constructeur, dans le cadre d’un déploiement annoncé au Moyen-Orient et sur plusieurs marchés de la région. La documentation officielle de Tesla précise que l’utilisation de Grok nécessite un véhicule équipé d’un processeur multimédia AMD, ainsi que la version logicielle 2026.32.6 ou une version ultérieure. Le véhicule doit également disposer d’un abonnement Premium Connectivity actif ou d’une connexion Wi-Fi. Aucun compte Grok distinct n’est requis pour utiliser l’assistant embarqué. Cette extension intervient après une publication du compte officiel Tesla EMEA annonçant l’arrivée de Grok au Moyen-Orient et au Maroc, sans préciser alors les marchés concernés ni le calendrier logiciel. Les pages d’assistance régionales du constructeur ont depuis apporté davantage de précisions, notamment pour Israël, le Qatar, les Émirats arabes unis, l’Arabie saoudite et la Jordanie. Un assistant intégré au véhicule Une fois la version compatible installée, Grok doit apparaître automatiquement dans le lanceur d’applications du véhicule. Le conducteur pourra également le solliciter à partir du bouton microphone situé sur le volant ou au moyen de la commande vocale « Hey Grok ». Dans son mode « Assistant », l’outil ne se limite pas aux réponses conversationnelles. Tesla indique qu’il peut intervenir sur plusieurs fonctions du véhicule, notamment la navigation, les appels téléphoniques, la lecture multimédia et certains réglages de la climatisation. Il peut également répondre à des questions en s’appuyant sur le manuel numérique du propriétaire et programmer des rappels associés à une localisation. L’intégration doit par ailleurs continuer à évoluer. Des modifications récentes du manuel du propriétaire de Tesla font notamment apparaître une future capacité permettant à Grok de composer et d’envoyer des messages texte à partir de commandes vocales. Tesla n’a toutefois pas indiqué la version logicielle qui permettra cette fonction, ni communiqué de calendrier pour son activation. Le Maroc dans le périmètre de Tesla La documentation officielle consacrée à la connectivité identifie désormais le Maroc dans la rubrique africaine du constructeur et associe Grok aux fonctionnalités disponibles dans le cadre de ses services connectés. Cette mention vient compléter l’annonce de Tesla EMEA concernant l’extension de l’assistant au Maroc. Pour les propriétaires marocains de Tesla compatibles, l’arrivée de Grok dépend désormais du déploiement de la mise à jour logicielle correspondante. Tesla ne communique pas, dans ses pages d’assistance, de date précise pour l’installation de la version 2026.32.6 au Maroc. Les utilisateurs pourront vérifier la version logicielle de leur véhicule depuis le menu « Commandes », puis « Logiciel ». Après installation d’une version compatible, l’application Grok doit apparaître dans le lanceur. The post Tesla déploie Grok au Maroc appeared first on Hespress Français - Actualités du Maroc .

items.title: ‘Most important trophy now is the next game’ – Carlos Queiroz
items.description: Black Stars head coach Carlos Queiroz says Ghana must focus on winning their next game as they begin their 2027 Africa Cup of Nations qualifying campaign. Ghana will open their Group C campaign against Côte d’Ivoire in Bouaké on Thursday before hosting The Gambia four days later. With two crucial fixtures coming up, Queiroz says the Black Stars must take the campaign one game at a time. “There is always a new challenge. For me the most important trophy at this moment is the next game, to win the next game,” Queiroz said. “You cannot be on the top roof of Accra without climbing the steps of the building and the steps for us now are to win the next game.” Ghana missed out on the 2025 Africa Cup of Nations and will be hoping to avoid another qualification setback as they begin their journey towards the 2027 tournament. Their first test will be a difficult away clash against Côte d’Ivoire in Bouaké before they return home to face The Gambia in Accra on September 29. Queiroz has also had to make several changes to his squad ahead of the opening fixture. Mohammed Kudus and Nathaniel Adjei have withdrawn through injury, while Thomas Partey was not invited due to his hamstring problems. Alidu Seidu, Jonas Adjetey, Mohammed Fuseini and Brandon Thomas-Asante have since been called up as replacements. Despite the changes to his squad, Queiroz remains focused on the immediate task at hand. The Black Stars must first overcome Côte d’Ivoire before turning their attention to The Gambia as they look to make a positive start to their 2027 AFCON qualification campaign.

items.title: Tinubu understands my Rainbow Coalition – Wike
items.description: By Omeiza Ajayi Federal Capital Territory FCT minister, Nyesom Wike, has said President Bola Tinubu fully understands the concept behind his Rainbow Coalition project, insisting that the sustained attacks on the initiative are being driven by Imo State Governor, Hope Uzodinma, whose ambition to become Senate President ahead of the expiration of his tenure has fuelled the crisis. Speaking during a live interview on TVC on Monday night, Wike, who is also the national leader of the Peoples Democratic Party PDP, dismissed claims that the Rainbow Coalition posed any threat to President Tinubu’s re-election bid, describing the criticism as coming from someone seeking to cause crisis within the system rather than tell Nigerians the truth. He said, “In a country like this, somebody whose tenure will be expiring in 10-11 months time, now because of wanting to change or cause crisis within the system, wants run for election to the Senate Presidency, and without telling people the truth, he Is now saying the Rainbow Coalition is a problem. How will the Rainbow Coalition be a problem? Mr President, everyone in all the states, support the President. You want to run for Senate, House of Reps, Governorship? it is your internal affair,” Wike said. He explained that the coalition’s only position was that Nigerians across parties should support Tinubu’s re-election, while leaving room for members to pursue their own political ambitions at the state and National Assembly levels. “All they want me to do is to say, since they are supporting the President, nobody should run for National Assembly, nobody should run for State Assembly, nobody should run for Governorship. Where do you see that happening? Then they will call me to tell me, can we produce candidates of your party? Come on, who does that? No, sorry, I don’t,” he said. Wike also dismissed reports that the President had agreed to concede nine states to him as part of the coalition arrangement, challenging those spreading the claim to name the states in question. “First of all, did they tell you the nine states? No, they didn’t tell me. You see, we owe Nigerians the truth. Tell them the truth. Which are those nine states? State A, state B, state C?” he said, insisting that such propaganda could not have come from anyone genuinely working for the President’s re-election. The minister pointed to the President’s position on creation of state police and the South-East presidency question as evidence of Tinubu’s boldness in tackling issues previous leaders avoided. “Mr President has taken the bull by the horns and said, state police should be considered. People are saying, to solve our security problem, we must have a state police. Mr President has come out boldly to say, I am in support of what they are saying. We must implement it. How many people have done that?” he said, adding that he had never seen a president as committed to devolving power to sub-national governments. “I have never seen, with all due respect, a man who believes that power should go down, make the rural areas, local governments, state governments have funds to develop. I have never seen that happen. I was governor. I know what I suffered.” On suggestions that his coalition activities were positioning him to succeed Tinubu in 2031, Wike again rejected the claim, maintaining that his interests could not collide with the President’s since Tinubu would not be seeking re-election at that point. He said questions about his ambition were misplaced given his political standing. “By the grace of God, I don’t think there’s anything a politician wants today that President Tinubu has not made me to achieve. And people should stop talking about ambition, ambition.” Wike further argued that resistance to the Rainbow Coalition stemmed from a fear of losing control over key National Assembly positions rather than genuine concern for the President’s interest. “For Mr President to win, not only a party. It’s not only APC supporting President, PDP supporting him, Labour supporting him, this party supporting him. You’re not happy. Simply because you know that you will not be in control. You are not going to be the one that will be in control of who will be Senate President? You want to make President to be a lame President. It will not work. President must still have that hand,” he said. Asked whether he had reached out to the roughly three All Progressives Congress (APC) governors he does not appear to trust, Wike said there was no need for such moves in the absence of a genuine issue, adding that Tinubu had not called him over the matter because none existed. “Why would the President call me, is there any issue? The President will call you when there are issues, when he knows, look, this will give me problems. Of course, he is President and a politician. Who doesn’t know him that he’s a master strategist in this game?” he asked. The minister drew a distinction between the governors he considered cordial and those he accused of manufacturing grievances against him, describing the Governor of Kwara State, AbdulRahman AbdulRazaq, as very timid. “I don’t carry anybody’s fight. You have a problem with Saraki? You go and fight with Saraki. Why do you, as a politician, fall into the trap of Saraki? He (AbdulRazaq) carries propaganda every day against me. “Have you forgotten all these people who fought me? When this fight was going on, they supported my colleagues and told my colleagues to deal with me, that enough is enough of me. My colleagues joined them. Now I have won. And now you want something from me? You say you want me to be a houseboy. Houseboy for what? That’s not possible. The point is that go and fight your fight,” he declared. The post Tinubu understands my Rainbow Coalition – Wike appeared first on Vanguard News .

items.title: PM Shehbaz arrives in New York to present Pakistan's position on regional, global security at UNGA
items.description: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif arrived in the United States on Monday to attend the 81st session of the United Nations General Assembly (UNGA) in New York, his office said. The premier was received at the airport by Pakistan’s Permanent Representative to the United Nations, Asim Iftikhar Ahmad. PM Shehbaz is slated to address the 81st session of the United Nations General Assembly on Sept 25, where the Gulf conflict is expected to overshadow much of the high-level debate. The official theme of the 81st session is ‘Restoring Trust, Managing Transformation: A United Nations That Delivers for All’, and the UNGA debate is expected to run from Sept 22 to 26, with a final sitting on Sept 28. However, ongoing fighting between Washington and Tehran is expected to feature prominently in discussions among world leaders, particularly over the security of the Strait of Hormuz, regional stability and the possibility of finding a diplomatic way out of the confrontation. “In his address, the prime minister will present Pakistan’s position on the changing situation regarding regional and global security, emphasising the importance of dialogue, diplomacy, and peaceful resolution of conflicts,” the statement by the Prime Minister’s Office said. It added that the premier would highlight Pakistan’s “active diplomatic and mediation efforts for eliminating tensions in the region and promoting peace and stability, while also presenting Pakistan’s priorities on key global issues, including sustainable development, climate change, the fight against terrorism, Islamophobia, and global economic challenges”. The prime minister would also draw the attention of the international community to the long-standing issues of “occupation and denial” of the right to self-determination in India-occupied Kashmir and Palestine, the statement said. He would participate in several high-level meetings related to development, climate action, and other important matters during the UNGA session and present Pakistan’s position, it said, adding that the premier would hold bilateral meetings with various world leaders present at the session, as well as and the UN secretary general. The premier had on Thursday reached London for a two-day stopover before proceeding to the United States. Dar’s bilateral meetings Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar arrived in New York ahead of the premier on Monday to participate in the UNGA session, the Foreign Office (FO) said. On the sidelines of the session, the deputy premier met with France’s Foreign Minister Jean-Noel Barrot, and the two reviewed Pakistan-France bilateral relations and exchanged views on regional and global developments. According to a statement by the FO, Dar “reiterated Pakistan’s desire to further strengthen bilateral ties, including through enhanced political engagement, trade and investment, educational linkages and people-to-people exchanges”. The two also discussed Palestine, stressing that the issue must remain “high on the international agenda”. The deputy prime minister appreciated France’s efforts to support the two-state solution. Barrot, meanwhile, appreciated Pakistan’s diplomatic efforts for peace and stability in the region. On the topic of Iran, “both sides exchanged views on the importance of continued diplomatic engagement and regional efforts to address the crisis, and highlighted the importance of implementing the Islamabad MoU,” the statement said. They also stressed the need to ensure the “safety and free flow” of maritime traffic and uninterrupted energy supplies. The French foreign minister agreed on the importance of utilising regional forums to address regional challenges and promote dialogue, the FO statement added. Separately, DPM Dar also met with Egyptian foreign minister Badr Abdelatty. The two ministers reaffirmed the longstanding fraternal ties between Pakistan and Egypt and expressed commitment to further strengthening bilateral cooperation in “diverse areas, including trade and investment, economic cooperation, education, cultural exchanges and people-to-people contacts”, the FO said. They also discussed regional and international developments, including the situation in the Middle East. They reaffirmed the importance of continued consultations under the Regional Four (R4) framework and agreed to further deepen coordination on issues of common interest, the statement added. The minister also met with the Permanent Observer of Palestine to the United Nations, Ambassador Riyad Mansour, at the UN Headquarters. During the meeting, he reaffirmed Pakistan’s “unwavering support” for the Palestinian cause and people, including their “inalienable right to self-determination and an independent, contiguous and sovereign Palestinian State”. “Pakistan will continue to strongly raise the issue during UNGA and at all relevant forums … and advance international efforts for an immediate end to the suffering in Gaza and a just and lasting peace,” the FO reported Dar as saying. He also met European Union High Representative for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy Kaja Kallas and stressed the significance of GSP+ status for Pakistan’s trade relations with the EU. In a post on social media platform X, the FO said DPM Dar had a “full programme” of high-level engagements in the week. “He will participate in ministerial forums and deliver Pakistan’s statements and interventions on key issues of importance to Pakistan, including bilateral, regional and international priorities across the UN agenda,” the FO said. Alongside accompanying Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif — who is due to arrive in New York later this week — DPM Dar will hold a series of bilateral meetings with his counterparts and participate in a range of high-level engagements on the sidelines of the UNGA, it added. Upon arriving in New York on Monday, Dar was received by Pakistan’s Permanent Representative to the UN Asim Iftikhar Ahmad, Ambassador to the US Rizwan Saeed Sheikh, Pakistan Consul General in New York Aamer Ahmad Atozai, and officers of Pakistan’s Mission to the UN and Consulate in New York. In a curtain raiser posted on X on Sunday, the FO said that during the visit, Dar will attend the meeting of the Organisation of Islamic Cooperation (OIC) Contact Group on Jammu and Kashmir, where he will highlight Pakistan’s “unwavering support” for the right to self-determination for Kashmiris. DPM Dar will also attend several high-level meetings on the Palestine issue, including a meeting of the eight Arab-Islamic countries and a high-level ministerial meeting of the global alliance for the implementation of the two-state solution, among others. According to the FO, DPM Dar is also expected to deliver a statement during the UN Security Council high-level briefing on artificial intelligence. He will also chair a meeting of the Economic Cooperation Organisation’s Council of Ministers. The Pakistani delegation at the UNGA has been significantly streamlined as part of the government’s austerity measures . Dar and senior foreign-policy adviser Tariq Fatemi form the core of the prime minister’s delegation. Several federal ministers who were initially expected to travel were dropped from the trip, according to sources at the country’s UN mission.
